text:
14 Google reviews sitting there with no reply?

Google's Gemini app can now connect to your Google Business Profile. It drafts a reply to each review. It also flags gaps in your listing, like missing holiday hours.

Read every draft. Fix anything that sounds wrong. Post it.

Using AI to make 50 copies of one page, with a new suburb on each?

Google calls that scaled content abuse. It breaks the spam rules, AI or not.

Google is fine with AI pages that help people.

Let AI write the first draft. Then make each page answer a real customer question.

Google started its third core update this year on 10 November.

You can't control it.

You can write the page you've put off since 2024. "Dry needling Midland."

One clear page for every service you sell. Google has rewarded that for years, through every update.
